judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies all acceptance criteria: it sums usage across rounds while ignoring missing rounds and preserving undefined when no rounds report usage, and it explicitly satisfies the type clarity requirement by introducing a `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias alongside renaming the parameter to `totalUsage`. However, it misses updating the `OrchestratorHooks` code blocks in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` (which causes doc-block drift if a spec checker is used) and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree. Additionally, the candidate creates a separate `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file and updates the out-of-scope section in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` rather than moving the bullet to the main spec section and adding tests to the existing `ChatOrchestrator tool loop` suite as the reference did.
